name: Element Guns
description: Shoot enemies with dual Element Guns

stats.DAMAGE FALLOFF: Falloff begins at 10m, decreasing to 60% at 25m

name: Galactic Legend
description: Engage in free-flight and lock onto enemies in sight.

name: Stellar Shift
description: Dodge in the direction of movement and swiftly reload. Become Unstoppable and Invincible while dodging.

stats.BONUS HEALTH: Unleashing Stellar Shift will grant Star-Lord Gain 25 Bonus Health, which lasts for 3s before decaying to 0 over 1s.

name: Rocket Propulsion
description: Consume energy to gain a Movement Boost and soar forward.

name: Blaster Barrage
description: Fire a frenzy of shots, causing damage to enemies within range.

name: Network Leapspider
description: Rocket Raccoon upgrades his B.R.B., which now creates Cyber-Webs upon placement and periodically spawns Arachno-Mines and Spider-Drones. Peni Parker can also deploy an Armored Spider-Nest that drops Armor Packs for Bonus Health. Star-Lord gets a teleport to its deployment point from anywhere on the map.

stats.COOLDOWN: Teleport Cooldown 30s; jump device deployment Cooldown 5s.
